method: Two img2img passes in a local ComfyUI (no network service) over a composite of the selected T7c concept's harbour view. The game hazes its lower part (art/backdrop_haze.gdshader).

init.layout: 1536x864: the concept's columns x 1180-1536 (right), the same column mirrored (left), and x 830-1180 stretched between (centre, hidden behind the lane in play)

passes.negative: people, text, watermark, signature, blurry, lowres, seams, duplicate, frame, border, mirrored

passes.why: Pass 1's mirrored left half repeated the dome and lighthouse; patch.py paints open sea over them before this light pass.
passes.negative: people, text, watermark, signature, blurry, lowres, seams, duplicate, frame, border, mirrored, tiled, repeated pattern

sampler.positive: masterpiece, best quality, scenery, no humans, sunny mediterranean harbour town seen from a high hillside, terracotta tiled roofs, cream and salmon plaster houses with green shutters, cypress trees, glass dome in a small square, harbour with sailboats and stone pier, white lighthouse on a rocky islet, calm blue open sea with a few small sailboats, distant green headland, soft white clouds, warm late morning light, painterly hand-painted background, soft brush texture, consistent lighting

rejected: Four text-only candidates (seeds 71028, 281026, 90417) ignored the hillside vantage (a pier foreground, floating islands, cliffs), and a third composite with open sea on its left (seed 1029) left a hard seam. None are kept.
status: Starter backdrop. Its hidden centre still shows two cottages from the concept, behind the lane.
